I stayed at Trans International, and while there were some positive aspects, my experience was marred by several inconveniences. The room had some extra furniture around the bed that made moving around quite difficult, and the mattress was noticeably smaller than the bed frame, which impacted the overall comfort.

The AC remote was in poor condition, making it hard to adjust the temperature, and the TV channels seemed outdated, limiting our entertainment options. One of the biggest drawbacks was that we had to go to a different branch of the hotel chain for breakfast, which was quite inconvenient.

On the positive side, privacy was well-maintained, and the service was generally good. The hotel also allowed outside food, which was a nice touch. However, the issues with the room setup and amenities definitely affected my overall satisfaction.
